# System evaluation (auto-generated)

Generated by `python -m eval.run_system_eval` at 2026-09-28T17:08:16.673572+00:00 · prompt v3.1.0 · pricing 2026-09 (assumed list prices; verify before external use).

**Mode: LIVE LLM — proposed system with the real model**

Workload split: **test** — 132 cases generated from the warehouse with oracle labels (`eval/workload.py`, seed 11).
The dev split (seed 7) was used while building and debugging; the test split (seed 11: different customers and phrase picks) was generated after the last design change and is the one reported.
22 case types × 12 country·segment cells × ES/PT. Intervals are Wilson 95%; with zero observed events the 95% upper bound is ≈3/n.
Portuguese turns are team-written (the dataset has no Portuguese).

## PROJECTION — not a measurement
Assumptions: all text-channel Transaccional contacts are in scope for this workflow (upper bound); the live model's SAR on held-out synthetic cases transfers to production traffic (unverified); no phone channel (voice needs STT; not built).
Measured text-channel Transaccional contacts/month ≈ 1,005. Using this run's SAR (0.95) ⇒ ≈ 955 contacts/month and ≈ 58.6 agent-hours/month, each skipping a measured ~120s queue wait. This SAR is a live model's on held-out synthetic cases; production traffic may differ. Not a production measurement.

ROI per resolution (model costs measured in this run; loaded contact-center agent cost per hour, assumed (not in the data): 5, 10 and 20 USD; every text contact is sent to the model once per turn (cost per attempted case)). Model cost per safe resolution: USD 0.0029.

| Assumed agent cost per hour | Human cost per contact | Monthly human cost avoided | Monthly model cost | Monthly net |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| USD 5 | USD 0.31 | USD 293.10 | USD 1.42 | USD 291.68 |
| USD 10 | USD 0.61 | USD 586.20 | USD 1.42 | USD 584.78 |
| USD 20 | USD 1.23 | USD 1,172.40 | USD 1.42 | USD 1,170.98 |
